_readme: Routes on ride pages (Oct 9, 2026). One entry per ride slug: { gpx, posted, from, by, for_date, pace_mph, drop, regroup, cues, note } — field notes in tools/lib/routes.js. Only from the people who run the ride (or Robert's own ride file with their OK); never from Strava's API. After an edit: python3 tools/route-build.py <slug>, then node tools/build-rides.js.

scottsdale-az-scottsdale-cycling-saturda.note: Robert’s own ride of his first TSR, Oct 10, 2026: from the 6:00 am meet at Gainey Village to where he turned for home at mile 44. His ride that day, not the club’s published route.

scottsdale-az-bicycle-haus-friday-shop-r.note: Robert’s own ride of the Friday shop ride, Oct 9, 2026: from the shop to La Grande Orange, the way the group rode it that morning.
